[center][size=5][color=#F4C95D][b]WHAT IS SEXY COMBAT IDOLS?[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[b]Sexy Combat Idols - Reloaded StandAlone![/b] turns collectible Idol Cards into living combat companions. Equip a card and its Idol manifests beside you, follows you through the world and fights with a complete class kit—not a recycled pet attack.

Every Idol belongs to one of [b]13 fully distinct combat classes[/b], each with its own attack pattern, resource mechanic, skills, audiovisual identity, Stage-2 Awakening and Ultimate. Collect cards, open packs, build stars, train rarity, develop careers, form friendships, send teams on expeditions and descend into an optional roguelite Gauntlet.

[center][color=#86EFAC][b]This is a standalone card and combat system.[/b][/color]
[b]Sexy Market Idols is NOT required. No third-party card API. No foreign card DLL. No Content Patcher.[/b][/center]


[color=#F25F7A]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/color]

[center][size=5][color=#6DD5FA][b]WHAT “STANDALONE” MEANS[/b][/color][/size][/center]

SCI owns the complete runtime itself:

[list]
[*][b]Its own card catalog and card instances[/b]—every duplicate remains a real, individually tracked card.[/*]
[*][b]Its own save collection[/b]—ownership lives only inside SCI's save data.[/*]
[*][b]Its own Star Shard wallet[/b], selling flow, Star Forge and duplicate-condensing system.[/*]
[*][b]Its own card packs[/b], monster drops, pity system, rarity rolls and cinematic reveal screens.[/*]
[*][b]Its own Combat Archive[/b], detail pages, progression menus and companion equipment flow.[/*]
[*][b]Its own combat engine[/b]—damage, targeting, knockback, kill credit, VFX, audio and class mechanics are handled centrally by SCI.[/*]
[/list]
[b]SCI card packs are simple art/data content packs for this mod, not another runtime mod.[/b] Install at least one compatible SCI card pack so the catalog has Idols to draw. If your main download already bundles a card pack, there is nothing extra to configure.

[color=#ffffff]Historical creator packs made for Sexy Market Idols or SCI legacy can still be discovered [b]read-only[/b] when they contain a valid SCI combat archetype. Their existing card IDs remain unchanged, and Sexy Market Idols itself still does not need to be installed. [/color]

[center][size=5][color=#F4C95D][b]THE CORE LOOP[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][b]FIGHT[/b] → [b]EARN CARD PACKS[/b] → [b]REVEAL IDOLS[/b] → [b]TRAIN & BOND[/b] → [b]AWAKEN[/b] → [b]PUSH DEEPER[/b][/center]

[list]
[*]Begin a new save with starter packs once an SCI card catalog is available.[/*]
[*]Defeat monsters for configurable Idol Card Pack drops; dry streaks are protected by pity and elites receive a higher drop weight.[/*]
[*]Open packs through a dedicated reveal sequence and roll Common, Rare, Epic or Legendary card instances.[/*]
[*]Equip one Idol as your active companion and develop that exact card over time.[/*]
[*]Earn levels, stats, skill choices, stars, career ranks, affinity, memories and combat records.[/*]
[*]Reach Level 20, build the relationship and forge a Star Sigil to unlock Stage 2.[/*]
[*]Continue to Level 50 with an awakened job, stronger class identity, new skills, a new Ultimate and a visible aura/palette transformation.[/*]
[/list]
[color=#F25F7A]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/color]

[center][size=5][color=#C99CFF][b]13 CLASSES · 13 COMPLETELY DIFFERENT KITS[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[color=#FF8A65][b]BRAWLER → BERSERKER[/b][/color]
Build [b]Tremor[/b], break enemy posture with exclusive Stagger, crack the ground and finish fights with [b]Earthquake[/b].

[color=#FF5C8A][b]STRIKER → BLADE DANCER[/b][/color]
Fight at extreme speed with twin blades, [b]Momentum[/b], Hemorrhage stacks, dash cuts and the lethal [b]Crimson Waltz[/b].

[color=#B8A1FF][b]MONK → SHADOW MONK[/b][/color]
Blink between targets, rise through four [b]Chi Aura[/b] tiers, unleash echo strikes and suspend the battlefield in [b]Stillness of the Eternal Pause[/b].

[color=#FFE29A][b]PRIESTESS → ORACLE[/b][/color]
Channel holy beams, build [b]Faith[/b], rescue a wounded Farmer, heal inside Sanctuary and call down [b]Celestial Judgment[/b].

[color=#64E9FF][b]STORMBRINGER → TEMPEST[/b][/color]
Apply Wet, build Storm Charges, chain lightning through groups, detonate Discharge and become the center of the [b]Tempest Eye[/b].

[color=#A78BFA][b]SUMMONER → NECROMANCER[/b][/color]
Brand enemies with Shadow Marks, launch shards, summon creatures and guardians, then flood the screen with the [b]Swarm[/b].

[color=#FF315D][b]YANDERE → BLOODBINDER[/b][/color]
Fight through two emotional states, [b]Obsession[/b], Heart Marks and the permanent Red Thread. Her power keeps its dangerous HP-cost identity and culminates in a [b]Bloody Wedding[/b].

[color=#FF9DE2][b]DANCER → DIVA[/b][/color]
Build [b]Rhythm[/b], throw class-specific chakrams, rotate performance buffs, chase PERFECT timing and turn combat into [b]Showtime[/b].

[color=#F6C453][b]GUNSLINGER → GUNNER[/b][/color]
Fire rapid dual pistols, mark targets for Deadeye finishers and unload the cinematic [b]Dead Man's Volley[/b].

[color=#8BE8FF][b]FROST MAGE → GLACIAL SAGE[/b][/color]
Stack Chill, Freeze targets, shatter them through Thermal Shock and lock an entire encounter in [b]Absolute Zero[/b].

[color=#FF6B6B][b]SAMURAI → DAIMYO[/b][/color]
Master Ken, Iaijutsu, Zanshin, parries and a spirit-katana presentation before consuming everything in one decisive [b]Void Slash[/b].

[color=#9A7CFF][b]REAPER → DEATH GOD[/b][/color]
Harvest Souls with a true scythe, enter a transformed Harvest state, open graves under marked enemies and lead the [b]Death God's Procession[/b].

[color=#7EE7B8][b]ROGUE → PHANTOM[/b][/color]
Exploit Vulnerability, steal gold, vanish through smoke and ricochet precision shots through the chaotic [b]Phantom's Gambit[/b].

[center][size=5][color=#F4C95D][b]DEEP IDOL PROGRESSION[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[list]
[*][b]Levels 1–50:[/b] Stage 1 develops toward Level 20; Awakening opens the continuous path to Level 50.[/*]
[*][b]Awakening 2.0:[/b] a five-phase transformation ceremony, Stage-2 class job, visible aura, new milestones and a global damage upgrade.[/*]
[*][b]Career ranks 1–10:[/b] earn Career Points, titles and kit modules as an Idol grows from nervous trainee into a confident star.[/*]
[*][b]Idol stamina:[/b] performances consume a meaningful day resource. Rest, sleep, Duet nodes and career perks keep your roster relevant instead of making one card infinite.[/*]
[*][b]Idol Star Chart:[/b] choose class skills and Duet-support nodes through a dedicated constellation-style skill tree.[/*]
[*][b]Rarity training:[/b] a Common Idol can personally ask for training, offer quest choices and ascend toward Legendary through combat milestones.[/*]
[*][b]Stars and duplicates:[/b] improve cards in the Star Forge or safely condense an unused duplicate into a free star.[/*]
[*][b]Star Stamps:[/b] collect six stamp types, improve them to Level 3 and equip up to two per Idol for build-defining effects.[/*]
[*][b]Oath:[/b] a Stage-2 Idol at 20 hearts can forge a permanent endgame bond with its own visual identity and stat reward.[/*]
[/list]
[color=#F25F7A]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/color]

[center][size=5][color=#FF9DE2][b]LIVING IDOLS · NOT SILENT SUMMONS[/b][/color][/size][/center]

Your active Idol has a life beyond attack cooldowns.

[list]
[*]A Stardew-style dialogue overlay with animated portraits, expressions, typewriter text and character-specific voice blips.[/*]
[*]Class voices and personality overlays that change as affinity and career confidence grow.[/*]
[*]Morning greetings, idle emotes, location comments, combat reactions and proactive “I need to tell you something” moments.[/*]
[*]Daily gifts with Loved, Liked, Neutral and Disliked reactions shaped by personality and mood.[/*]
[*]Chats, three-way questions and a compliment system where you learn what each personality values.[/*]
[*]Mood, context and memory: low health, rain, late nights, mines, gifts, heart events and important victories can return in later conversations.[/*]
[*]Heart events at major relationship milestones, followed by deeper post-Awakening story tiers up to 20 hearts.[/*]
[*]Optional canon dossiers in modern card packs for public facade, private truth, values, attachment style, voice and personal boundaries.[/*]
[/list]
[center][color=#FF9DE2][b]All Combat Idols depicted by SCI card packs are adult characters.[/b][/color][/center]

[color=#F25F7A]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/color]

[center][size=5][color=#86EFAC][b]FRIENDSHIP, MENTORING & EXPEDITIONS[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[color=#86EFAC][b]Best Friends & Mentoring[/b][/color]

Pair two Idols and let them grow together. Bond levels unlock permanent training milestones, while the Mentor system lets you choose which stats one partner teaches the other. Trainer Quality makes the teacher's own strengths matter—an Idol cannot convincingly teach a stat she never mastered herself.

[color=#86EFAC][b]Sexy Adventures[/b][/color]

Send reserve Idols on off-screen expeditions while your active fighter stays with you. Missions have regions, durations, success chances, team composition, MVP/underperformer results, XP, loot, exhaustion and optional date-night affinity. Multiple expeditions can run at once, and supported regions can include Stardew Valley Expanded when installed.

[color=#F25F7A]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/color]

[center][size=5][color=#FF6B6B][b]RELOADED COMBAT WORLD[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[list]
[*][b]Rival Girls:[/b] generated enemy Idols appear in solo mine runs as Trainees, Elites and Bosses. They use lighter versions of all 13 class kits, telegraphed skills, formations and class traits. Rival Bosses can drop their own card with pity protection.[/*]
[*][b]16 signature bosses:[/b] floor-tiered encounters with telegraphs, special attacks, add phases and enrages.[/*]
[*][b]Elite affixes:[/b] Explosive, Vampiric, Frosty, Hasty, Armored and Splitter combinations change how elites must be approached.[/*]
[*][b]Depth scaling:[/b] Skull Cavern remains relevant through configurable enemy health, damage, reward and pressure curves.[/*]
[*][b]Difficulty 2.0:[/b] adjust challenge, population, encounter style, Farmer contribution, reward policy and fine-grained pressure settings.[/*]
[*][b]Idol Gauntlet:[/b] unlock the Star Shrine and enter a roguelite descent with escalating waves, Arcana modifiers, choice rewards, boss intervals, a run bank and the decision to cash out or risk everything.[/*]
[*][b]Combo ranks D → SSS:[/b] keep kills flowing for style ranks and configurable bonus XP.[/*]
[/list]
[color=#FF6B6B][b]Gore & Juice—fully configurable[/b][/color]

Hits and kills can trigger hitstop, screen shake, directional splatter, monster-specific chunks, pixel giblets, short-lived ragdolls and blood decals that remain until you leave. Choose [b]Off, Confetti, Normal or Extreme[/b], toggle hit gore and persistent blood separately, and cap particles for performance.

[color=#6DD5FA][b]VFX, sound and dynamic music[/b][/color]

Every class has dedicated impact language: blade trails, muzzle flashes, ice shatters, chain lightning, shadow summons, holy glyphs, soul wisps, comic hit words, Ultimate cinematics and more. A dynamic music director can react to normal combat, bosses, climaxes, victory and Awakening while respecting the game's volume settings.

[center][size=5][color=#F6C453][b]THE FARMER JOINS THE DUET[/b][/color][/size][/center]

While an Idol Card is equipped, the Farmer receives a visible virtual sidearm—no inventory weapon slot required.

[list]
[*]One attack input can trigger the Idol and the Farmer together, each with an independent cooldown and shared target.[/*]
[*]Four gun tiers, weapon upgrades from +0 to +10, ammunition crafting and a dedicated NPC-free Gun Forge.[/*]
[*]Farmer Gunslinger levels, stat points and a separate Star Chart with passive and proc-based skills.[/*]
[*]Equipment rarity and FP/DX/EN rolls that actually feed into combat.[/*]
[*]Tracers, muzzle flash, smoke, shell casings, recoil and optional terrain destruction for rocks, ore and barrels.[/*]
[*]Farmer gun kills correctly count for loot, Adventurer's Guild goals, Slay-Monster quests and Special Orders.[/*]
[/list]
The Farmer is tuned as the [b]sidekick[/b]. The Idol remains the star of the fight.

[color=#F25F7A]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/color]

[center][size=5][color=#6DD5FA][b]TWO COMBAT CONTROL STYLES[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[color=#6DD5FA][b]DUET[/b][/color]

You call the basic attacks while the Idol positions, follows and executes her kit. The Farmer's sidearm can fire with the same input, creating a synchronized two-character combat rhythm.

[color=#C99CFF][b]AUTONOMOUS[/b][/color]

The Idol seeks valid targets, moves into class range and fights independently while you mine, reposition or use tools. She still respects collision, line of sight, range and class rules.

[b]Default controls[/b]

[list]
[*][b]Y / Controller Y:[/b] open the active Idol Hub.[/*]
[*][b]K:[/b] open the Combat Archive.[/*]
[*][b]Q:[/b] open Sexy Adventures.[/*]
[*][b]Primary attack / Controller X in Duet:[/b] Idol attack + Farmer sidearm.[/*]
[*][b]Secondary action / Controller A:[/b] Ultimate when charged.[/*]
[/list]
Keys, combat mode and most major systems are configurable.

[center][size=5][color=#F4C95D][b]INSTALLATION[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI 4.0+[/url].[/*]
[*]Extract the [b]SexyCombatIdols[/b] folder into your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Install at least one SCI card content pack beside it. If the main download already contains one, keep the included folder structure.[/*]
[*]Optional: install Generic Mod Config Menu.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
On a fresh save, SCI grants starter packs after it detects at least one valid card in the catalog. Existing standalone SCI saves keep their cards, stars, affinity, training and friendships.

[color=#F25F7A]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/color]

[center][size=5][color=#C99CFF][b]COMPATIBILITY & CO-OP NOTES[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[list]
[*][b]Historical creator packs:[/b] supported through a narrow read-only compatibility path when their cards declare a valid SCI archetype.[/*]
[*][b]Stable card identities:[/b] published card IDs remain persistent, so upgrades and relationships stay attached to the correct instance.[/*]
[*][b]Missing pack files:[/b] SCI does not silently delete saved card instances, but their art/data cannot be shown correctly until the pack returns.[/*]
[*][b]Co-op:[/b] persistent collection, career, training and friendship data are host-owned. Install matching SCI files and card packs for all players.[/*]
[*][b]Rival Girls:[/b] intentionally solo-only because custom rival NPC subclasses cannot safely use vanilla multiplayer synchronization.[/*]
[*][b]Stardew Valley Expanded:[/b] not required; expedition support can use it when present.[/*]
[/list]
[color=#F25F7A]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/color]

[center][size=5][color=#F4C95D][b]FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[color=#6DD5FA][b]Do I need Sexy Market Idols?[/b][/color]

[b]No.[/b] SCI owns its collection, wallet, packs, archive, Forge, UI and combat runtime. Legacy pack reading is compatibility, not a dependency.

[color=#6DD5FA][b]Do I need Content Patcher?[/b][/color]

[b]No.[/b] SCI is a SMAPI C# mod and loads its own targeted content packs.

[color=#6DD5FA][b]Why do I need a card pack if the mod is standalone?[/b][/color]

“Standalone” means no second card [i]system[/i] or runtime mod is required. Card packs only provide characters, portraits, sprites and metadata directly to SCI—just like content for the same mod.

[color=#6DD5FA][b]Can Common cards become Legendary?[/b][/color]

[b]Yes.[/b] Long-term Idol Training can ascend the rarity of the exact card you fought beside.

[color=#6DD5FA][b]Can I turn off gore, rivals, bosses, stamina, the Farmer gun or automatic card drops?[/b][/color]

[b]Yes.[/b] Major systems have dedicated switches or tuning controls. Generic Mod Config Menu is the easiest way to edit them in game.

[color=#6DD5FA][b]Is this only an auto-battle mod?[/b][/color]

[b]No.[/b] Use Autonomous mode for hands-off companion combat or Duet mode for direct attack timing and synchronized Farmer fire.

[color=#6DD5FA][b]Do companion kills count for quests and loot?[/b][/color]

[b]Yes.[/b] Companion and Farmer-gun kills are routed through SCI's kill-credit pipeline for loot, Guild goals, Slay-Monster quests and Special Orders.
